_why: EVERY ANSWER FOR THE apps.gov.in UPLOAD FORM, EACH WITH ITS EVIDENCE, so the owner types from this file
and never from memory. Text fields are never copied here: a `from` names the listing file beside this
one, which is the single copy (the guards hold those files to the form's limits).
STAMPED by tooling/bricks/app with the answers that are true of the CHASSIS, which is exactly what a
freshly stamped app is. Re-read every step-3 answer when the app adds a feature: an app that starts
using the camera, location, contacts, the microphone or storage must say Yes there, and CI fails the
built .apk if it requests one of those permissions while this file says No
The owner fills exactly two fields at the sitting, supportEmail and supportPhone. Both are shown on the
store, and neither is written into this repository.
portalSource: apps.gov.in developer upload form, script /Developer/chunk-ZVEOEZCZ.js and the on-screen lists, read 2026-09-22. Private runbooks/store-submission-apps-gov-in.md 'Step 1' to 'Step 3'.

minimumPlatform.label: Nougat 7.0
minimumPlatform.source: the built .apk's minSdk (Flutter's default flutter.minSdkVersion, 24, which the chassis does not override), read in CI from `aapt2 dump badging` by tooling/ci/assert-apps-gov-in-apk.mjs, which fails if this sdk or label disagrees with the .apk. The label is the form's own name for SDK 24 (contracts/store/vocabulary.js STORE_FORM_RULES['apps-gov-in'].minPlatformLabels).

stateUt.why: A Nikatru app is not specific to one state or union territory. The form lists an app under the one chosen.

step1._supportWhy: Both are shown on the store. The phone field takes at most 12 characters. Neither is written into this repository.

authorizationLetter.why: The letter's control (financeDocument) is tied to the Finance category. category.txt is Others, so the control does not appear.

applicationType.why: The chassis talks to its backend when signed in, and has sign-in (step 3 question 11 is Yes).

paymentGateway.why: This channel's purchaseRail is `none` (tooling/channel-register.json apps-gov-in). A build with RELEASE_CHANNEL=apps-gov-in resolves the rail that sells nothing: packages/purchases/test/chassis_billing_test.dart, 'a `rail: none` channel is a rail that sells nothing'.

fileFormat.why: The form takes APK or AAB. With an APK the form asks no key-store question, and the .apk is signed with our own apps.gov.in key.

appFile.why: Built by the Android job of .github/workflows/build-platforms.yml. That artifact name exists only when the signer matches the pin recorded in tooling/channel-register.json apps-gov-in.signing.signingCertificate.sha256. Any other build is named ...-NOT-FOR-UPLOAD-<reason> and must never be uploaded (docs/ci/build-platforms.md).

keyStore.why: The form's script requires the key-store field only when File format is AAB. The .apk is signed in CI with alias nikatru-appsgovin (tooling/channel-register.json apps-gov-in.signing).

step3.question: Is the app developed in India?
step3.evidence: The developer profile is an Indian individual developer, approved 2026-08-31 (Private platform-state/identity.json storeAccounts.apps-gov-in).

step3.question: Does the app use personal data?
step3.evidence: The chassis's signed-in account holds an email address and a user id. Answer apps/{{app_id}}/store/android-play/data-safety.json too; the two must agree.

step3.question: Does the app use ad services?
step3.evidence: The chassis carries no ad SDK and no house ads. Answer apps/{{app_id}}/store/android-play/ads-declaration.json containsAds too; the two must agree.

step3.question: Any functionality associated with financial activities (i.e. invoking financial transaction through the app)?
step3.evidence: The apps-gov-in build sells nothing and opens no checkout: purchaseRail `none`, packages/purchases/test/chassis_billing_test.dart 'a `rail: none` channel is a rail that sells nothing'.

step3.question: Is the app suitable for children?
step3.evidence: No Nikatru app targets children; the age floor is 18 (ADR 068).

step3.question: Does the app access location?
step3.evidence: The chassis requests no ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION or ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION. CI re-checks this against the built .apk (tooling/ci/assert-apps-gov-in-apk.mjs).

step3.question: Does the app access the camera?
step3.evidence: The chassis requests no CAMERA. CI re-checks this against the built .apk.

step3.question: Does the app access contacts or call logs?
step3.evidence: The chassis requests no READ_CONTACTS, WRITE_CONTACTS, READ_CALL_LOG, WRITE_CALL_LOG or PROCESS_OUTGOING_CALLS. CI re-checks this against the built .apk.

step3.question: Does the app access the microphone?
step3.evidence: The chassis requests no RECORD_AUDIO. CI re-checks this against the built .apk.

step3.question: Does the app access storage?
step3.evidence: The chassis requests no READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE or READ_MEDIA_*. CI re-checks this against the built .apk.

step3.question: Does the app have user authentication?
